content:
Looking for new games for your iPhone and iPad? The App Store has a massive selection, completely ad-free and without in-app purchases.

Apple Arcade is a subscription service suitable for all ages, but it's not your only option. If you're already a Netflix subscriber, you can actually play many excellent iPhone and iPad games.

Your Netflix subscription already includes a massive library of iPhone and iPad games.

Every Netflix plan comes with a rich library of mobile and TV games.

This includes the cheapest ad-supported Standard plan at just US$8.99 (approximately HK$70) per month.

Regardless of which Netflix plan you've chosen, you can instantly start playing mobile and TV games, with no ads, no in-app purchases, and no extra fees.

Speaking of TV games, Netflix has an app designed specifically for iPhone and iPad called Netflix Game Controller.

This app can turn your phone or tablet into a game controller, to be used with a compatible Netflix smart TV app. If you want to further enhance your mobile gaming experience, buying a dedicated iPhone game controller is also a good option.

Netflix also has another iPhone and iPad app called Netflix Playground, which contains mini-games designed for children. Other options include "Netflix Puzzled: Logic Games" (no subscription required) and "Netflix Stories".

In addition to the above games, Netflix supports over 80 iPhone and iPad games. You can download any of them from the App Store, then log in with your Netflix email and password to start playing.
